title: Status of Second Schedule
summary: This thread tracks the formal status of the Second Schedule, noting its eventual repeal in certain contexts.

evolution.validity: Transitioned from an active legal instrument to a repealed status.

timeline.change: Declaration of the schedule as repealed.

member_objects.resolved_text:
প্রথম তফসিল
( বাংলাদেশ কাস্টমস ট্যারিফ )

দ্বিতীয় তফসিল
(বিলুপ্ত)

তৃতীয় তফসিল

First Schedule: This schedule contains the Bangladesh Customs Tariff, which serves as the foundational classification for goods under the Customs Act.
Second Schedule: This schedule has been repealed and is no longer in effect.
Third Schedule: This schedule forms part of the administrative structure of the Customs Act.
Bangladesh Customs Tariff: The Bangladesh Customs Tariff is established under the First Schedule of the Customs Act.
